description: Visual sensor with perfect detection: an entity is a contact when it is within `range_m` meters (3D distance, inclusive), inside the horizontal field of view centred on the heading (`fov_deg` degrees, edge inclusive) and visible from this entity's eyes, `eye_height_m` meters above its position, to the other entity's eyes (terrain line of sight). With `eye_height_m = 0` two entities on smooth ground never see each other.

params_schema.title: builtin.visual parameters
params_schema.description: Visual sensor with perfect detection: an entity is a contact when it is within `range_m` meters (3D distance, inclusive), inside the horizontal field of view centred on the heading (`fov_deg` degrees, edge inclusive) and visible from this entity's eyes, `eye_height_m` meters above its position, to the other entity's eyes (terrain line of sight). With `eye_height_m = 0` two entities on smooth ground never see each other.

fov_deg.description: Horizontal field of view in degrees, centred on the heading; 360 sees all around.

eye_height_m.description: Height of the eyes above the entity's position in meters, for the line-of-sight test.

description: Fires the weapon named by `weapon` at the entity stored in the blackboard key `target_key` and succeeds in the same tick. Fails, without firing, when the key is unset or the entity is not a current contact. Firing is only recorded in this version; it has no effect on the target. Contacts are the entities this entity's sensors see this tick; without a sensor there are none.

params_schema.title: builtin.action.fire parameters
params_schema.description: Fires the weapon named by `weapon` at the entity stored in the blackboard key `target_key` and succeeds in the same tick. Fails, without firing, when the key is unset or the entity is not a current contact. Firing is only recorded in this version; it has no effect on the target. Contacts are the entities this entity's sensors see this tick; without a sensor there are none.

target_key.description: Blackboard key of type entity that holds the target. The leaf only reads this key.

weapon.description: Weapon label in the namespaced id form, for example example.weapon.main_gun.

description: Follows the route and cruise speed given in the scenario. Running until the last waypoint is reached, then Success; it keeps holding at the last waypoint after Success. Fails when the entity has no route. Takes no parameters.

params_schema.title: builtin.action.follow_route parameters
params_schema.description: Follows the route and cruise speed given in the scenario. Running until the last waypoint is reached, then Success; it keeps holding at the last waypoint after Success. Fails when the entity has no route. Takes no parameters.

description: Moves toward the entity stored in the blackboard key `target_key` at `speed_mps`. Running while the target is farther than `arrival_radius_m`, Success once it is within that distance. Fails when the key is unset or the entity is not a current contact. Contacts are the entities this entity's sensors see this tick; without a sensor there are none.

params_schema.title: builtin.action.move_to parameters
params_schema.description: Moves toward the entity stored in the blackboard key `target_key` at `speed_mps`. Running while the target is farther than `arrival_radius_m`, Success once it is within that distance. Fails when the key is unset or the entity is not a current contact. Contacts are the entities this entity's sensors see this tick; without a sensor there are none.

target_key.description: Blackboard key of type entity that holds the target. The leaf only reads this key.

speed_mps.description: Cruise speed in meters per second (the motion model clamps it to its limits).

arrival_radius_m.description: Distance in meters at or below which the action succeeds.

description: Holds position for `duration_s` seconds, rounded up to whole ticks and counted from the node's first tick. Running until then, then Success. Starts over after it has finished or has been halted.

params_schema.title: builtin.action.wait parameters
params_schema.description: Holds position for `duration_s` seconds, rounded up to whole ticks and counted from the node's first tick. Running until then, then Success. Starts over after it has finished or has been halted.

duration_s.description: How long to wait in seconds.

description: Succeeds with the given `probability`. Every evaluation draws exactly one number from the entity's own random stream, so results depend on the scenario seed and repeat exactly with the same seed. Probability 0 never succeeds and 1 always does.

params_schema.title: builtin.cond.chance parameters
params_schema.description: Succeeds with the given `probability`. Every evaluation draws exactly one number from the entity's own random stream, so results depend on the scenario seed and repeat exactly with the same seed. Probability 0 never succeeds and 1 always does.

description: Succeeds when a hostile contact is within `range_m` meters. Hostile means both entities have a force and the forces differ; an entity without a force is neutral and never hostile. With `store_as`, the nearest hostile contact (ties: lowest entity id) is written to that blackboard key. Contacts are the entities this entity's sensors see this tick; without a sensor there are none.

params_schema.title: builtin.cond.enemy_in_range parameters
params_schema.description: Succeeds when a hostile contact is within `range_m` meters. Hostile means both entities have a force and the forces differ; an entity without a force is neutral and never hostile. With `store_as`, the nearest hostile contact (ties: lowest entity id) is written to that blackboard key. Contacts are the entities this entity's sensors see this tick; without a sensor there are none.

range_m.description: Maximum distance in meters (3D range of the contact, inclusive).

store_as.description: Optional blackboard key of type entity that receives the nearest hostile contact on success. The key must be declared in the graph's [blackboard] table. Left unchanged on failure.

description: Succeeds when the entity stored in the blackboard key `target_key` is a current contact within `range_m` meters. Fails when the key is unset or the entity is not (or no longer) a contact. Contacts are the entities this entity's sensors see this tick; without a sensor there are none.

params_schema.title: builtin.cond.target_in_range parameters
params_schema.description: Succeeds when the entity stored in the blackboard key `target_key` is a current contact within `range_m` meters. Fails when the key is unset or the entity is not (or no longer) a contact. Contacts are the entities this entity's sensors see this tick; without a sensor there are none.

target_key.description: Blackboard key of type entity that holds the target. The leaf only reads this key.

range_m.description: Maximum distance in meters (3D range of the contact, inclusive).

description: Succeeds once the simulation time since the start of the run is at least `duration_s` seconds, rounded up to whole ticks. It measures the run, not the time since the node last ran; for a relative delay use builtin.action.wait.

params_schema.title: builtin.cond.timer_elapsed parameters
params_schema.description: Succeeds once the simulation time since the start of the run is at least `duration_s` seconds, rounded up to whole ticks. It measures the run, not the time since the node last ran; for a relative delay use builtin.action.wait.

duration_s.description: Run time in seconds after which the condition succeeds.
